title: Project Manager
summary: Direct electrical (LV, MV and HV) and mechanical piping/HVAC construction projects, from initial concept through final handover.
description: Direct electrical (LV, MV and HV) and mechanical piping/HVAC construction projects, from initial concept through final handover.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Chair project handovers, coordinate staffing and establish business plans, cost frameworks, cashflow and billing schedules.
Develop procurement and design schedules, construction programmes, S-curves and histograms.
Mobilise labour, subcontractors and site facilities; develop safety and quality plans.
Oversee daily site operations, EHS compliance, training and subcontractor reviews.
Coordinate cost and sales tracking with the Quantity Surveyor; monitor productivity and report progress.
Manage testing, commissioning, audits, life-safety certification, O&M manuals and record drawings.
Finalise accounts, demobilise sites, archive documentation, submit close-out reports and support warranty periods.
Maintain site logs, information security and continuous improvement.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: At least three years managing M&E projects across the construction lifecycle.
Knowledge of construction methods, building regulations and budget control.
Unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Attention to detail, commercial awareness, leadership, problem-solving and communication.
